title.narrative: Technology for Truce Monitoring, Peace-building, and Protection in Yemen

description.narrative: Contract related to: Technology for Truce Monitoring, Peace-building, and Protection in Yemen - This 18-month measure builds on efforts commenced in a previous phase and will deliver tailor-made tools to support the monitoring by the Office of the Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yeme (OSESGY) of the parties¿ adherence to the truce, in preparation for an eventual longer-term cessation of violence. The action will support further development of conflict resolution tools to enable more evidence-based decision-making, de-escalation and mediation using input from conflict participants, third-party monitors, and relevant open media. Furthermore, the action will train new field observers on truce commitments monitoring, primarily focusing on commitments regarding shipments, air flights, and road openings.
